primary_sources.description: RIPA — Racial and Identity Profiling Act — mandatory stop data collection and reporting
Original RIPA enactment — established per-stop data collection mandate, RIPA Board, DOJ reporting
Prohibition on racial and identity profiling — defines 'racial and identity profiling' operative in § 12525.5 analysis
Public repository of agency-level RIPA data — accessible without PRA at openjustice.doj.ca.gov
Extended RIPA data collection requirements to all agencies statewide by July 1, 2023
